svg.title: ThingsBoard 3.6 Rule Node 外部集成独立时序

g.text: ThingsBoard 3.6 Rule Node 外部集成独立时序
公共 Actor 入口与 force_ack 分叉
release-3.6 没有 TbNodeCallback 类型。
消息级契约是 TbMsgCallback；后续协议 callback 是另一层。
HTTP：不预连接，future 回调决定 2xx/Failure
Actor call path waits on old futures
destroy() only shuts down a node-owned Netty EventLoopGroup.
Shared EventLoopGroup belongs to the application.
Proxy Apache async client is not explicitly closed by this class.
MQTT：init 同步连接，消息 publish future 异步
throw; Actor init retry may rebuild node
Node code invokes publish once and defines no message retry/reconnect loop.
QoS 1 is protocol behavior, not Rule Engine exactly-once.
destroy() calls disconnect() without an explicit await/flush.
otherProperties may override; PEM newline conversion
publish catches and logs debug only
release-3.6 gap: no Failure relation and the executor future is not observed.
force_ack=false may leave the original callback open;
force_ack=true has already completed the original callback.
邮件：同步校验，MailExecutor 同池嵌套
The submitted inner future is not canceled.
SMTP send may continue and succeed after the Failure relation.
relation 收敛与数据库边界
Runtime HTTP/MQTT/Kafka/SMTP paths do not write a business DB row or outbox.
Rule Node configuration is separately stored in rule_node.configuration.
debugMode may separately persist Debug Event; successful email updates usage counters.
No database transaction spans the Rule Engine callback and any external side effect.
